title: Wheelchair access to scenic overlooks and state trails
summary: As of September 10, 2026, a commissioner said the commission has taken no action yet on a request about accessible state trails. The issue arose on August 13, when a testifier asked for short, paved paths so wheelchair users can reach scenic overlooks. It was also said then that the topic could be placed on the next meeting's agenda.

timeline.text: A commissioner said there was no commission action yet on a request about accessible state trails.
The trail-access topic from public testimony could be placed on the next meeting's agenda.
